note: Written for this studio. Each recipe runs one 3D model or one World Kit build; chains of several families are on the Pipelines page.

recipes.title: Picture to mesh: TRELLIS.2
recipes.pitch: One picture of an object becomes a mesh with TRELLIS.2, at real size, with a turntable.
recipes.why: The object is cut out of the picture, TRELLIS.2 builds the mesh, and World Kit's Blender step sets the real size and the pivot.

fields.label: The object
fields.default: an old brass ship's lantern with green glass

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: One object on a plain background is what the mesh model reads best.

steps.label: The picture
steps.prompt: {object}, a single object, the whole object in view, centred, three-quarter view, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos, no people.

proof.note: Never rendered through this recipe when it was written.
